_scenario: Eight hand-written polygons (convex, clockwise, concave L, comb, collinear run, one hole, two holes, hole in a concave outline) followed by 200 star outlines generated from SeededRandom(SEED) on an exact integer grid, about 40% of them carrying an axis-aligned box hole. Each is passed to triangulatePolygon; the resulting index array is checksummed per D6 and the per-shape (triangles, digest) pairs are checksummed in order. A refused shape records triangles = -1 and digest = 0, so what the module refuses is pinned alongside what it tessellates.
_tier: cross-platform (§33) — the strongest tier any determinism golden in this directory claims. The tessellator uses only +, -, *, / and comparisons on IEEE-754 doubles (exactly rounded by ECMA-262), SeededRandom.nextFloat01 scales a uint32 by an exact power of two, every coordinate is snapped to an integer, and the output is an integer index array. No step between the seed and these numbers is implementation-approximated.
